messages.text:
I’m going to avoid depending on the flaky server-function transform for runtime flows.

The app will still use TanStack Start backend boundaries, but via route handlers plus server-side loaders: SSR reads directly from the local DB, browser navigations and mutations use `/api/*` handlers.

That is a steadier production shape here.
